711034401.text: Uh... Looks like there's another realm in here...

711034402.text: Huh? Hilichurls! Get behind us, Mao!

711034403.text: Hehe... Stuff like this happens sometimes, but my friend would always chase them away, so... I'm not scared at all!

711034404.text: Your friend must be pretty strong... Could she be some sorta adeptus too...?

711034405.text: Well... I wouldn't say so. In fact, she forbade me from talking about her willy-nilly, so... Well, sorry.

711034406.text: Eh? Come on, no need to apologize!

711030501.text: This is it! It's the clue I wanted to show you before, right here!

711030502.text: ...What on Teyvat is that? It's so covered in moss that Paimon can't make heads or tails of it.

711030503.text: Ehhh? There wasn't any moss the last time I came here...

711030504.text: No need to worry, Little Mao! It's so humid here that it's no wonder there's moss growing everywhere. Hmm, there must be a way to clear it away...

711030701.text: #Look, {NICKNAME}, look! It's a scene of ancient people attending a festival and performing a ritual. Pretty different from the festivals we have today, huh?

711030702.text: Although the grown-ups in the city and the village all say that the Lord of Geo was the first to arrive in Chenyu Vale, I've heard that the people in the picture actually got here even earlier than he did!

711030703.text: People back then used to throw bits of magic jade into the river, and they'd float along until they sank to the bottom. They saw it as a way to guarantee good weather, prevent the river from flooding, and ensure that the soil would be fertile.

711030704.text: Based on what we previously discussed, I'm guessing that Chenyu Vale will only be fixed after we've found some jade that was thrown into the river in ancient times! That makes sense, doesn't it?

711030705.text: Wow, you're so knowledgeable! Was your friend also the one who told you these stories?

711030707.text: Hmph! Little Mao's a local, so of course he understands this place better than Paimon!

711030709.text: Yep, and... Everyone'll be really blessed and live happily ever after, and all that...

711030710.text: Hehe, but I much prefer hearing her stories about ancient wars and battles... She told me that the warriors back then were all giants who were over ten feet tall!

711030711.text: The warriors of Chenyu Vale were covered in tattoos, and they had these massive jade axes that could chop a person in half in the blink of an eye!

711030712.text: And the Millelith, led by none other than the Lord of Geo himself, were even tougher! They clad themselves in suits of armor that weighed over a thousand pounds and fought with hundred-pound spears! Apparently, everyone was at war back then, so much so that Bishui River turned crimson red...

711030713.text: Later on, the mountains to the south became full of ghosts from that era. Even now, those who wander through the mountains might still be able to catch their singing on the wind...

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the watchtower at Yilong Wharf

711030901.text: Look! From up here, you can clearly see how the water moves faster through those narrows, then slows down again as the river widens out. The jade must have stopped there! We should find what we're looking for there.

711030902.text: Wow, you're such a real whiz-kid! Paimon's been wondering though... What's that massive thing in the distance?

711030903.text: That huge thing is the Jademouth, a legendary "jade ring" that an adeptus threw into the water!

711030904.text: Oh... But the river curves around there, so the current should actually speed up.

711030905.text: But the river gradually gets wider there.

711030906.text: Yeah, so the rapid flow around the bend might have resulted in things being deposited along the convex bank where it widens... So there's actually a good chance that the jade is at the bottom of the river somewhere around Jademouth. Of course, that's assuming that the course of the river hasn't been artificially altered!

711030907.text: Hmm, not to mention... There's a fisherman's legend that goes something like... "Jade shall rise from sunken mouth"... or something like that. Anyway, let's go over and take a look around first.

711030908.text: Compared to Little Mao, Paimon feels like she's completely out of her depth...

711030909.text: Hehe, it's because my friend is amazing! She knows everything there is to know about the mountains, and she's taught me loads too — that's how I've learned so much.

711030911.text: Uhh, that's not what I meant! I mean, you unblocked the cave and got rid of that moss in a flash, after all, and I have no idea how you even did that!

711030912.text: I'm just kidding, don't overthink it.

711030917.text: Whatever the case, let's go down and get on a bamboo raft!

711030918.text: Hoho, yeah! Jademouth, here we come!

711030914.text: #...{NICKNAME}, has the rarefied mountain air or miasma gone to your head or something? Or does the adeptal energy you used have side effects? You're behaving pretty strangely...

711030916.text: Yeah... That's right! Paimon has lots of other strengths...

subQuests.subQuestName: Board the bamboo raft and go to the Jademouth

711034701.text: Someone coming aboard? ...Wait, is that Little Mao? Come, come, I'll take you!

subQuests.subQuestName: Listen to stories of the past

711031001.text: We're here, this is the Jademouth!

711031002.text: Such a huge hunk of jade, and even the other pieces on it are massive! Whoever it was that threw it down, adeptus or not, must have been absolutely titanic!

711031003.text: Hehe, adepti come in all shapes and sizes. "They could be as tall as the clouds, or small enough to hide amidst pool and leaf..." Agh, how did the rest of it go again... anyway, you get the picture! To sum up, adepti rule!

711031101.text: Well, here's the Jademouth. But how are we gonna find all that jade underwater?

711031102.text: Ah, so that's how it is. "...The spring's cries ripple through the vales, the shrines depart from northeast shores..."

711031103.text: "The heights and shallows in the southwest hide, sun and earth from each other divide, the eternal whirlpool that never churns, the beautiful jade concealed within..."

711031104.text: What's that Little Mao's singing about? It sounds pretty complicated...

711031105.text: It's one of our local folksongs, I heard an old granny singing it as she was gathering herbs! It means... If you look out from the center of the river to the banks on either side, you'll see two stone shrines hidden to the northeast and the southwest. These shrines keep the mighty whirlpool in the center suppressed...

711031106.text: Paimon understood the last bit! So the jade is all hidden beneath the whirlpool?

711031107.text: Yep! Sounds like we're going treasure hunting, hooray!

711031108.text: But the area between the northeast and southwest is so huge! After all, in a broad sense, the northeast and southwest of Jademouth can include... pretty much the whole world?

711031109.text: You're always thinking outside the box, Ms. Paimon! But there's no need to worry, I already have an idea where the shrines will be, because... Well, my friend told me! Come on, let's roll.

711031112.text: Does anyone else think a giant maelstrom suddenly appearing here might not be too great?

711031113.text: Oh, yeah! Won't that mean that boats will no longer be able to sail in and out of Yilong Wharf?

711031114.text: Oh, don't worry about that! My friend told me that once we've done what we need to beneath, the whirlpool will disappear completely! Otherwise, how would all the old boatmen carry on making a living?

711031115.text: Wow, so it's not just a smart whirlpool, but a considerate one to boot! Let's get going then!

711032101.text: Huh. We haven't seen the whirlpool from the song yet...

711032103.text: #How about... Giving that "adeptal energy" of yours a try, {NICKNAME}?

711032601.text: #{NICKNAME} and Paimon, we meet again. And who might this be?

711032602.text: Huh? You haven't met before? This is Little Mao, he's helped us so much along the way.

711032603.text: No, we haven't met before. But you must be a good child, Little Mao.

711032604.text: Hello, and yes, that's me! Miss, are you... an adeptus? You are, aren't you?

711032606.text: #Hehe, thanks for all the help you've given {NICKNAME} and Paimon, Little Mao.

711032607.text: It's really the legendary Fujin, in the flesh! I can't believe this, I've heard so many stories about you! And... Now I know that you're not some kind of big, slippery Carp, but a lady instead, like a big sister!

711032608.text: B—Big Carp!? Honestly, what kind of stories have you been listening to, Little Mao?

711032609.text: Ahem...! One is indeed an adeptus, and as such, can take forms as one pleases. This particular form seemed like the most approachable one for conversing with humans...

711032610.text: Hmm, from what you've said... You have a very unique scent, Little Mao. Have you met someone in the mountains before? Someone with golden eyes and a fair complexion, perhaps?

711032611.text: Uh, not exactly... Big Sis Fujin, you're not talking about one of your other friends, are you? My friend from the mountains doesn't sparkle like you do, but she's also really cool! She's helped me tons and taught me loads...

711032612.text: So it was her after all...

711032613.text: So your friend wasn't Adeptus Fujin after all, huh?

711032614.text: But Big Sis Fujin's my friend too now, isn't she?

711032615.text: Of course, Little Mao! I am delighted to have made friends with you.

711032617.text: ...But I've met more! Whoop whoop, go me! I win!

711032620.text: #Uhh... Don't worry about {F#her}{M#him}. Anyway, does that mean Little Mao's friend is also an adeptus?

711032622.text: As for whether Little Mao's friend counts as an adeptus or not... I'm not quite sure myself. After all, "adeptus" is merely a title — and it's hard to say whether adepti are even "people."

711032623.text: The word "adeptus" is just like any other word, such as "hero," "villain," or "idiot"... No one is born an adeptus, and no one shall remain an adeptus forever.

711032624.text: That's true... So you've met that friend of Little Mao's that we were talking about, right?

711032625.text: Indeed. But it's been a long, long time since last I saw her. So now... I suspect that I don't know her half as well as Little Mao does. I'm not even sure if I still count as her friend.

711032626.text: According to what Little Mao said...

711033901.text: Huh. Seems like the jade's starting to move...

711033902.text: That's right. But according to the story, the riverbed should have lots of other Votive Rainjades. Why does Big Sis Fujin only want this one?

711033903.text: #Look! It's shining, almost as if it's resonating with the adeptal energy on you, {NICKNAME}!

711033904.text: Why don't we try using that power, eh?

711033905.text: That should do it. Wow, awesome! It suddenly became small!

711033906.text: Yeah! Paimon didn't think it'd just change size like that. Guess that's a millennia-old treasure for you... It's just like you said, Little Mao! "They could be as tall as the clouds, or small enough to hide amidst pool and leaf..."

711033907.text: #Yeah! Well, looks like the Votive Rainjade's in our hands now. You're so reliable, {NICKNAME}!

711033909.text: Ms. Paimon's amazing! So you're going to take us to that "deep pool shrouded in cloud and mist to the south" now, right?

711033910.text: Clouds and mist... Hmm... I think Chenyu Vale really does have places like that.

711033911.text: But where? Tell us, little guide, and Paimon'll take you there!

711033912.text: Do you remember the place Mountain mentioned, the spot where we met? That place is super foggy, and I know of a secret cavern that leads there. Even the other locals don't know about it.

711033913.text: It was my friend who showed me the way, and since you're my friend too, Paimon, I'll tell you all about it!

711033915.text: Hehe, of course. Uh, well, you're both pretty impressive too!

711033918.text: Well, any friend of yours is a friend of ours too! In fact, Paimon hopes we'll meet her on the way.

711033919.text: Shall we go? Paimon's gonna take you all to the... place you mentioned, Little Mao!

711033917.text: ...She's told me lots of stories, and quite a few of them were about Big Sis Fujin.

711030299.text: You're the one who needs to be careful... Paimon can fly, after all!

711030298.text: Watch your step... There's moss on the cliff, it's slippery!

711031398.text: Wow, she's... she really was right about you. You're pretty out of the ordinary.

711031598.text: Wow, you're amazing! Even my friend couldn't do anything about the shrines!

711032597.text: Wow! And just like the legend says, a Golden Carp!

711032598.text: Huh, so it's Adeptus Fujin again!

711034899.text: As the river breeze blows, you hitch a ride on the rocking bamboo raft,\nAnd you slowly reach the Jademouth.

711038101.text: Here we are. There's a cavern behind this waterfall. Try not to get soaked, you might catch a cold!

711038103.text: #Um, how about you give that "adeptal energy" a go, {NICKNAME}?

711038201.text: There's more water in here than before. Maybe I'll have to swim in next time.

711038601.text: Look at that bamboo raft. Guess we've got a boat we can take now!

711038701.text: Alright, boatman, take us to the Jademouth!

711038702.text: Alright, Jademouth it is! The other two, you're... tourists? Haha, well if you're here for sightseeing, there's not many locals who head that way.

711038703.text: Hehe, you could say that! Mr. Boatman, are there any stories about the Jademouth that I haven't heard before?

711038704.text: Knowing you and how much you love your stories, kiddo, you must have heard them all by now!

711038705.text: Tell me more, tell me more!

711038706.text: Alright then... Well, I've heard it mentioned that the Jademouth was left behind by Rex Lapis when he marched through here to save the people of Chenyu Vale. Legend has it that to prevent a naval advance from downstream, the local adepti...

711038707.text: You're making it up as you go again, gramps! There's no way that Liyue's navy came up this river! I've heard that the Jademouth was formed by a piece of jade left behind by a giant Carp!

711038708.text: In those days, a baddie god tried to redirect the river to drown the Millelith stationed on both of the banks in Chenyu Vale, but a giant white snake and a giant Carp who were her subordinates disobeyed her orders. The giant white snake held up the baddie god, while the giant Carp...

711038709.text: She threw the jades she wore here. The jades pinned the river down, and ever since, we've had no more floods, and everyone can live peaceful lives on both sides of the river.

711038710.text: Hehe, you might understand a lot kiddo, but you haven't seen much. Take a closer look — there aren't any crops by this river!

711038711.text: See, after it was pinned down by the jades, it's true that the river hasn't flooded... But that's also meant it hasn't been able to provide irrigation for crops! So what was once a wide, gently-flowing river is today a narrow, rapid-flowing torrent instead.

711038712.text: Such a river leaves no sustenance for the earth on its banks. Haha, and of course that also means no people living peaceful lives on both its sides...

711038713.text: Paimon gets it now... But did you just say that the adepti were resisting the Lord of Geo, Little Mao?

711038714.text: That's how it was, all that time ago... Some people believe that the first lord of all Liyue was Rex Lapis. But in Chenyu Vale, we believe that before he came, there were other gods and adepti who protected our ancestors.

711038715.text: I've heard Grandpa Lu say that the tea ceremony is actually for the Carp adeptus who planted our first tea tree!

711038716.text: Oooh... But aren't these adepti meant to be the baddies? They were serving under a baddie god, after all!

711038717.text: In some stories they're the baddies, while in others they're the goodies. But it was all such a long, long time ago. Even the grown-ups don't remember much, so they always try to bluff me.

711038718.text: Hehe... Talking about that friend of yours again? *sigh* How can such supernatural beings be held to our simple codes of right and wrong? As far as we're concerned, all the forces that have ever blessed and protected this land deserve our offerings.

711038720.text: Hahahaha! Alright then, time to get off — we're here!

711038801.text: Eh? We're not boarding? Well, guess we can just follow the riverbank instead!

711038802.text: The terrain here is pretty tough! Aren't you scared of danger, Little Mao?

711038803.text: Of course I am! But... I guess it's because you're afraid that you can bravely climb, right? If you weren't scared at all, you wouldn't care about what kind of roads or stones you tread on. Wouldn't that be more dangerous?

711038804.text: Hah, Paimon scared of these mountain roads even without worrying about all that...

711038805.text: Hahaha, are you afraid you'll fall off?

711038807.text: Speaking of which, I've heard that the Jademouth was formed by a piece of jade left behind by an adeptus named Fujin...

711038808.text: In those days, the local god — a real baddie, of course — tried to redirect the Bishui River to flood both banks in Chenyu Vale, but an adeptus who was her subordinate, Fujin, disobeyed her orders and threw the jades she wore here.

711038809.text: The jades pinned the river down, and ever since, we've had no more floods, and everyone can live peaceful lives on both sides of the river.

711038810.text: Huh? Fujin...? Paimon thinks we've met her...

711038811.text: Oh? So she was the adeptus you met?

711038812.text: That's right. She even asked us to perform a bunch of errands for her. Said she wanted our help solving Qiaoying Village's problems. According to her, things could get ugly if those issues keep piling up!

711039205.text: Sure. Remember to let me know when you're setting off.

711039301.text: You know, we might be able to call the whirlpool forth if we try using that adeptal energy!

711039403.text: Then let's be off, fellow spelunkers!

711039405.text: Seriously? There's no helping you, huh? Hang on a moment, alright, Little Mao?

711039406.text: Okay! The cavern's pretty dark, so you've gotta be careful!
